documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Pricol Ltd reported consolidated revenue of INR 1,077.9 crores for Q4 FY26 and close to INR 4,000 crores for the full year FY26, alongside an EBITDA margin of 13.29% for the quarter and 12.44% for the year. Management highlighted multiple macroeconomic headwinds including the West Asia crisis, rising polymer, aluminum, semiconductor, and freight costs, and currency depreciation. Despite these challenges and expected short-term softening in earnings, the company remains committed to its long-term investments, technology development, and a major capital expenditure cycle ranging between INR 680 crores to INR 700 crores for the year. Pricol Limited released its Q4 FY26 and full year FY26 earnings presentation, reporting a consolidated revenue from operations of INR 1,077.90 crores for Q4 FY26 and INR 3,963.85 crores for FY26. The company achieved a Profit After Tax (PAT) of INR 73.23 crores for the quarter and INR 250.80 crores for the full year.

guidance.claim: The company targets to increase exports to 10% of revenue in the coming years.
guidance.quote: And our goal is to take it to 10% of revenue in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects softening of earnings and slowing of the automotive sector due to geopolitical headwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: So, while we are not scaling back on any of our critical activities that is going to hamper the growth of the company, we do believe that there will be softening of earnings and slowing of the whole automotive sector on account of these geopolitical headwinds that are actually sending ripples across the world.

demand_outlook.claim: The management stated that volume market share has been maintained and value market share has increased.
demand_outlook.quote: We have maintained our market share by volume and increased our market share by value.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects a softening of P3L margins over two years before benefits kick in.
demand_outlook.quote: So, there will be a softening of margins over two years before the benefits of all of this start kicking in.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a center of excellence in polymer technology and forward recruiting personnel.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we are setting up a center of excellence in polymer technology. So, we will be forward investing in that. And also for the new plants that are coming up, we will be forward recruiting of personnel to commission those plants.

capex_expansion.claim: Production with BOE Varitronix is expected to commence in about 10 to 12 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Work is under progress on the equipment and the machinery and the buildings, and we will be commencing in about 10 to 12 months' production.

margins_costs.claim: Polymer prices have increased by about 55%, aluminum by about 62%, semiconductors by about 35%, and memory control devices by about 28%.
margins_costs.quote: Polymer prices have gone up by about 55%. Aluminum has gone up by about 62%. The semiconductors have gone up by about 35%. Memory control devices by about 28%.

margins_costs.claim: Inbound and outbound freight costs are spiraling out of control.
margins_costs.quote: Freight costs are also spiraling out of control both inbound and outbound freight.

margins_costs.claim: P3L generated an EBITDA of 9.24% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: For the year, P3L generated revenue of INR 924 crores with EBITDA of 9.24%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed LOIs for most cluster programs, ensuring no dip in market share for the next three years barring market degrowth.
orders_capacity.quote: I do not see any dip in market share because we have got confirmed LOIs for most of the programs. So, for the next three years, barring degrowth or slowing down of the market, loss of market share is not something that we need to fear about.

orders_capacity.claim: Pricol is unable to grow in plastics this year due to lack of capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In fact, so much so that in plastics, we are unable to grow this year because of lack of capacity, which is why you see the ROCE at a very high figure compared to what I had given guidance for because of sweating the capital assets.

orders_capacity.claim: About 75% to 80% of Tata cars come out with Pricol's clusters.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, about 75% to 80% of TATA cars are coming out with Pricol’s clusters and we are increasing our market share with TATA.

capital_allocation.claim: Actual net debt as of 31st March 2026 stood at INR 63.11 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to give you a perspective, barring the supplier discounting and the customer bill discounting which earlier was hitherto treated as trade payable, now actual borrowing as of 31st March 2026, net debt is INR 63.11 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended retaining the dividend at 200% for FY26 to conserve cash.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this is something that we took a conscious call yesterday. We had the subject of the dividend, and the entire Board, including myself, recommended that we retain it at a 200% dividend for the FY26, see the performance for the next six months, and then take a call on that subject.

capital_allocation.claim: Customer bill discounting and vendor bill discounting were regrouped from trade payables to short-term borrowings due to a change in IndAS.
capital_allocation.quote: There is a circular which came up saying that debt-like items to be regrouped, which the customer bill discounting and vendor bill discounting, which used to be classified under trade payable, have been regrouped to borrowing.

capital_allocation.claim: No final dividend is recommended for FY 2025-26 to conserve cash for future expansions.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering the ongoing economic crisis and to conserve the cash for future expansions, no final dividend is recommended by the Board for the FY 2025-26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year started with a semiconductor crisis, followed by a rare earth magnet crisis and the West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: This financial year started off with a semiconductor crisis, followed by a rare earth magnet crisis, followed by the West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rupee is on a free fall.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rupee is on a free fall.

risks_headwinds.claim: Active M&A negotiations and due diligence are in progress.
risks_headwinds.quote: In fact, we had a very long discussion at the Board meeting yesterday on the various assets that we are considering. And we have taken some calls. And actually, active negotiations and due diligence is in progress.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management states that forward looking statements involve known and unknown risks, contingencies, uncertainties, market conditions and other factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: Forward looking statements involve known and unknown risks, contingencies, uncertainties, market conditions and other factors which may cause the actual results, financial condition, performance or achievements of the Company or industry results to differ materially from the results, financial condition, performance or achievements expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: Production with BOE Varitronix will commence in about 10 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: Work is under progress on the equipment and the machinery and the buildings, and we will be commencing in about 10 to 12 months' production.

management_commitments.claim: With Domino, commercial readiness and early revenue trickling in is expected in 18 months to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: With Domino, more like 18 months to 24 months is where we will be ready, and the early stages of revenue will start trickling in, right?

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
